text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v3.2.0 -> 15% traffic in region EU/US. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC.
maya: rolling now, tagging QA. ping @ian for canary metrics.
ian: watching metrics. will call if errors or latency > 2x baseline.
ops-monitor-bot: [Alert] EU p99 latency increased 30% over baseline for model inference (19m avg).
samir: seeing slight 5xx bump on EU edge, small sample.
lisa: hold — keep at 15%, do NOT advance until we confirm kv cache status.
maya: pausing automated ramp. pinning release to v3.2.0 for EU. command: `deployctl pin --region eu --version v3.2.0`.
ian: running quick smoke: `curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood.test/predict -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .status`
ops-monitor-bot: CPU on inference-gpu-12 at 92% in eu-west-1.
samir: looks like a batch scheduling misconfig, ops team notified.
ops-lead: on it, throttling batch size for canary pool. ETA 6m.
maya: proposed rollback threshold: >1.5x p99 or error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m -> rollback.
lisa: agreed. also add circuit fallback to smaller model variant.
ian: ok to resume roll to 25% after 10m stable with p95 within 1.2x.
ops-monitor-bot: [Info] autoscaler activity: added 2 nodes to eu-canary-pool.
ops-lead: nodes added, batch size reduction applied, monitoring.
maya: thumbs up; will wait for 10m window; call `go` if stable.
ian: `go` in 10m unless someone vetoes.
samir: FYI adding temporary kvcache eviction logs: `logger: kvcache.eviction=1`
lisa: No veto. +1 to gradual advance.
deploy-bot: Rolling to 25% in EU now. change_id: c-2026-03-21-377777
ops-monitor-bot: [Alert] brief error spike resolved, error rate back to 0.12%.
maya: monitoring, nice. keep a close eye on embeddings latency.
ian: p95 at 1.08x baseline at +12m.
lisa: proceed to 40%? I suggest +1 step to 40 then hold.
maya: hold for 20m at 25% then reassess.
ian: sound plan.
ops-lead: infra follow-up: investigating root cause, will file RFC for queue balancing.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll update release notes with rollback criteria and pins.
samir: filing small incident note in postmortems channel.
deploy-bot: Rollout progress: EU 25% -> stable. US 15% -> stable.
maya: closing thread once we hit 40% and 30m stable. :white_check_mark:
